operations.text: PO-2026-1042 ERP latest_eta was October 20; Pacific Motion Systems confirmed a 21-day slip to November 10 (DOC-SUP-001), leaving only 120 warehouse drives usable. Contracted demand requires 240 drives (120 robots × 2 drives each); the shortfall is 120 drives. Without recovery, BayShip Fulfillment (40 units, SO-002) and NovaFab Manufacturing (20 units, SO-003) cannot ship by their November 6 promise date; SwiftLog Logistics (60 units, SO-001) is fully covered. Gross revenue exposure is $1,080,000 (60 at-risk units × $18,000). This exposure is not a realized loss.

qualification.text: Both Apex (AVL-HDR-200-02) and Summit Precision (AVL-HDR-200-03) are approved for HDR-200 Rev C through December 31, 2026. Written confirmations for both emergency offers are dated October 26, with acceptance deadlines expiring October 27. REC-001's 80 pilot drives hold pilot-owner release authorization, conditional on manager plan approval; handling cost is a $2,000 planning estimate. REC-002's 16 R&D drives are technically ineligible. Autonomous purchase and stock movement are prohibited; approval scope covers draft preparation only.

sourcing.text: Plans A and C each protect all 120 contracted units on time; Plan B leaves NovaFab's 20 units unbuilt and is not approval-eligible. Plan A commits $194,400 for 400 Apex units usable October 29, covering contracted demand and FC-001 forecast (130 units). Plan C combines the 80-unit REC-001 pilot transfer ($2,000 handling) with a 40-unit Summit PO ($22,000), totaling $24,000 immediate expenditure but leaves FC-001's 130 units unbuilt. Lower Plan C commitment is not economic savings. PO-2026-1042 remains open under all options.

summary.text: PO-2026-1042 slipped 21 days to November 10, creating a 120-drive shortfall against 240 contracted (120 robots × 2 drives); gross revenue exposure is $1,080,000 across 60 at-risk units — not a realized loss. Plans A and C each eliminate the shortfall on time; Plan B is ineligible. Plan A ($194,400) also covers the FC-001 forecast; Plan C ($24,000) does not — lower commitment is not economic savings. Both alternative suppliers hold valid HDR-200 Rev C approval; REC-002's 16 R&D drives are ineligible. Acceptance deadlines expire October 27; autonomous action is prohibited.

company_brain.text: The manager recovery approval limit is $250,000. Plan A (Apex only: 400 units × $486) totals $194,400 — within the limit and flagged approval_eligible. Plan C (hybrid: REC-001 pilot transfer + Summit 40-unit PO) totals $24,000 — also within the limit and flagged approval_eligible. Pacific PO-2026-1042 remains open separately at $164,800 and is excluded from both recovery expenditure figures; the difference between plans reflects a commitment comparison, not economic savings.
